close_reason: Task/copy now follows the canonical-template fetch-merge-create pattern from jmap-calendars-server event.rs:570-642. TasksBackend::copy_task trait method removed (pre-publish breaking change; not externally consumed). Per-create loop now: parse client id (required); get_objects::<Task>(from_account); merge client overrides on top of source; strip id; create_object::<Task>(to_account). Four tests: missing-id invalidProperties[id], unknown-source notFound, source-fetched-and-overlaid (title override visible in created entry), plus retained same-account / fromAccountNotFound / state-mismatch checks. Workspace tests 2186 passing. README + PLAN.md updated to drop copy_task references.
description: RFC 8620 §5.4: "The Foo object MUST contain an id property, which is the id (in the fromAccount) of the record to be copied." The id selects WHAT to copy; any other client-supplied properties override the source values. tasks-server handle_task_copy at task.rs:432-439 silently inserts a "placeholder" id when the client omits one, then deserializes the client payload directly into a Task and calls copy_task(from, to, task) — never reading from from_account_id. Net effect: tasks Task/copy is functionally identical to Task/set create against to_account_id, but pretends to be a copy. Fix (pattern from calendars-server event.rs:570-642): require client to supply id; fetch source Task via get_objects::<Task>(caller, from_account_id, &[source_id]); on not-found insert notFound; merge client-supplied properties on top of the serialized source (excluding id); strip id; deserialize merged value back into Task; call create_object::<Task>(caller, to_account_id, create_id, task). Drop/deprecate the bespoke copy_task trait method. Tests: missing id → invalidProperties{properties:[id]}; unknown id → notFound; source fetched and modifications overlaid correctly.
title: tasks-server: Task/copy — source-id semantics: fetch from source, merge client overrides, fresh server id (RFC 8620 §5.4)
